hypothesis: The omitted artifact_hit hook causes damage divergence on monster returning-weapon fumbles.
supportedSetup: Ordinary wielded aklys carried by a living confused uruk-hai; initialized room and floor map, source-valid throw direction, four forced legal RNG outcomes. Enter through m_throw, not direct artifact_hit injection. Fixture adapted from existing returning-aklys-lethal-cleanup test with independent seed and nonlethal HP.
expectedC: Only AKLYS occurs in the monster autoreturn table; no AKLYS artifact exists in the pinned catalog. Thus the artifact_hit condition cannot hold for supported catalog objects on this call path. Ordinary return fumble deals two HP with the chosen draws.
observedJS: Catalog intersection empty. Aklys fumble consumes rn2(5), rn2(100), rn2(2), rnd(3), reduces HP 30 to 28, puts weapon on floor, and never records artifact_hit as unported.
control: Ordinary aklys exercises the throw and fumble path; WAR_HAMMER is rejected by autoreturn_weapon despite the Mjollnir comment in mthrowu.js.
scope: A catalog/caller proof at these revisions, not blanket suppression of artifact_hit gaps. Invalidate when arwep, artifact catalog or the caller gate changes. A manually assigned artifact flag on an aklys is not a valid counterexample. No C gameplay recording claimed.
